name: Alexander Washington Adams
notable_stories: His existence was long a mystery to Missouri-based family researchers until he was located in Ohio records
He and his family were neighbors to his sister Harriet Josephine Gill
Earlier attempts to trace him failed. After 1860 the family seems to vanish from records, perhaps because of illness or a break-up, though two of the children reappear in 1880.
milestones: Married Christiana F. Konitzer (m. 26 May 1851, Columbus, Franklin County, Ohio)
Migrated from Virginia to Ohio via the National Road
Registered for the Civil War draft in 1863
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Siblings listed: George Francis #1, Magdalena, Mary, Harriet Josephine, Susan, and Ursula
No record that could be him in the 1840 census, in Virginia or elsewhere [Bill Allen, Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, 2011, line 4033]
Mentioned in Jose2's sketch as a brother of George F. Adams. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7342]
Disappears from records sometime before or during the Civil War [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8533]
